# Simpos Retail point-of-sale and multi-store inventory management web application built with Spring Boot 3, MongoDB, and Thymeleaf. ![Spring Boot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spring_Boot-3.2.4-6DB33F?style=flat-square&logo=springboot&logoColor=white) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17_LTS-ED8B00?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-7.0-47A248?style=flat-square&logo=mongodb&logoColor=white) ![Thymeleaf](https://img.shields.io/badge/Thymeleaf-3.x-005F0F?style=flat-square&logo=thymeleaf&logoColor=white) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Compose-2496ED?style=flat-square&logo=docker&logoColor=white) ## Features - **Session Authentication & Store Switching (`/`, `/login`)**: - **Administrator (`hamam` / `123`, `access = 1`)**: Access to executive analytics and cashier checkout (`/dashboard`), stock catalog (`/stock-barang`), financial ledger (`/finance`), and vendor bills (`/bill`). - **Cashier (`kasir` / `123`, `access = 2`)**: Redirected from `/` or `/dashboard` to the dedicated register (`/kasir`), with access to stock catalog, finance, and vendor bills plus active branch switching (`Toko 1`, `Toko 2`, `Toko 3`). - **Cashier Register & Barcode Scanning (`/kasir`, `/dashboard`)**: Product search by name/ID, camera barcode decoding via QuaggaJS (`0.12.1`), dynamic line-item cart totals, payment method selection (`CASH`, `QRIS`, `TRANSFER`), and printable receipt generation. - **Inventory Stock & Barcode Labels (`/stock-barang`)**: Public read-only stock view when unauthenticated; full create/edit/delete CRUD when logged in, purchase vs selling price tracking, `Toko 1` to `Toko 3` branch filtering, low-stock filtering (`< 5` / `>= 5`), and SVG barcode generation with JsBarcode (`3.11.5`). - **Financial Ledger & Excel Export (`/finance`)**: Gross revenue and unit sales summary, date-range and branch filters (`tgldari`, `tglsampai`, `pilihtoko`), recent saved HTML invoices, transaction editing/printing, and `.xlsx` export via SheetJS (`0.20.3`). - **Accounts Payable Ledger (`/bill`)**: Supplier bill CRUD with live search, payment status badges (`Lunas`, `Belum Dibayar`, `Belum Lunas`), remaining balance (`nominalMinus`), due dates, and client-side compressed JPEG payment proof images. - **Database Seeder (`/seed`)**: HTTP GET endpoint that creates or resets demo user credentials and seeds sample products and vendor bills when collections are empty. ## Tech Stack | Layer | Technology | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Backend** | Spring Boot `3.2.4` / Java `17` | MVC routing, REST APIs, and service layer | | **Database** | MongoDB `7.0` + Spring Data MongoDB | Document persistence across 6 collections | | **Templates & UI** | Thymeleaf + Soft UI Dashboard (Bootstrap 5) | Server-rendered dashboards and modals | | **Client Libraries** | QuaggaJS `0.12.1`, JsBarcode `3.11.5`, SheetJS `0.20.3` | Camera barcode scanning, SVG barcodes, Excel export | | **Containers** | Docker & Docker Compose | Local MongoDB container and containerized app build | ## Screenshots ### Authentication & Public Catalog | Desktop | Mobile | | :---: | :---: | | **Login Screen**

# VelvetSnap - Web Photobooth Kiosk

Fullstack web photobooth platform and operator dashboard built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Konva, and SQLite/LibSQL.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=next.js)
![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5-007ACC?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)
![Konva](https://img.shields.io/badge/Konva-10-0D9488?style=for-the-badge)
![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-LibSQL-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)

VelvetSnap provides a self-service photobooth kiosk workflow alongside a multi-account admin panel for managing photo strip templates, pricing, device status, branding, and QRIS payment transactions. It runs locally out of the box with SQLite (`local.db`) and local media uploads, with optional integrations for LibSQL/Turso, Cloudinary, Midtrans, DOKU SNAP QRIS, and Pixabay.

## Live URL

- **URL:** [https://photo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://photo.widifirmaan.web.id)

## Features

- **Dual Kiosk Themes (`/v1`, `/v2`):** Switch dynamically via admin settings between the Modern Kiosk interface (`/v1`) and the Vintage Newspaper editorial theme (`/v2`).
- **Guided Kiosk Stepper (`/?step=1..5`):** Walks guests through template selection, QRIS checkout (Midtrans / DOKU SNAP with operator bypass for offline or test events), camera capture, photo adjustment, and result download/print.
- **Webcam Capture & Clip Recording (`react-webcam`):** Live viewfinder with countdown timers, multi-slot capture progress, flash animation, and behind-the-scenes clip recording.
- **Photo Strip Compositing:** Real-time preview adjustments (zoom, pan, brightness, contrast, saturation, warm tone via CSS filters) rendered onto a high-resolution HTML5 Canvas 2D strip composite.
- **QR Ticket & Mobile Download (`/download`):** Generates scannable QR codes (`qrcode`) linking directly to digital strip downloads and printable photo layouts.
- **Admin Template Studio (`/admin/template-studio`):** Drag-and-drop canvas editor powered by `react-konva` with photo slot detection, green-screen chroma key removal, Pixabay asset search, and in-browser WebAssembly background removal (`@imgly/background-removal`).
- **Admin Dashboard, History, & Multi-Account RBAC (`/admin`):** Tracks total sessions, 7-day revenue (`status = 'PAID'`), active templates, filtered transaction history (`status`, `from`, `to`), carousel curation, kiosk device records, branding settings, and sub-account management (`root` and operator accounts).

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5
- **Canvas and Media:** Konva 10, `react-konva`, HTML5 Canvas 2D, `react-webcam`, `qrcode`, Lucide React
- **AI Background Removal:** `@imgly/background-removal` (WebAssembly in-browser runtime)
- **Database and Storage:** SQLite / LibSQL (`@libsql/client`), local upload storage (`.local-uploads/`) with optional Cloudinary upload support
- **Payments and Integrations (Optional):** Midtrans Snap, DOKU SNAP QRIS, Pixabay API
- **Security:** Web Crypto API (`PBKDF2` password hashing and session token verification)

## Local Setup

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ (tested with Node.js 26)
- npm

### Quick Start

1. **Install dependencies**

   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

2. **Configure environment variables (optional)**

   By default, the app uses `local.db` and `.local-uploads/`. To enable remote LibSQL/Turso, Cloudinary, Midtrans, DOKU QRIS, or Pixabay search, copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`:

   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env.local
   ```

3. **Initialize and seed the local SQLite database**

   ```bash
   npm run db:setup
   ```

   To wipe and recreate `local.db` from `schema.sql` and `scripts/seed.sql`:

   ```bash
   npm run db:reset
   ```

4. **Start the development server**

   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

5. **Open the application**

   - **Customer Kiosk:** `http://localhost:3000` (redirects automatically to `/v1` or `/v2`)
   - **Admin Portal:** `http://localhost:3000/admin/login`

# MoneW - Smart Money Management

Fullstack personal finance Progressive Web App built with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, and SQLite/LibSQL.

![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16-black?style=for-the-badge&logo=next.js)
![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5-007ACC?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)
![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-4-38B2AC?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)
![Framer Motion](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framer_Motion-12-0055FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=framer&logoColor=white)
![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-LibSQL-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)

MoneW tracks multi-wallet balances, transactions, receipt images, spending limits, and saved payment cards through a unified web interface and REST API. Data persists in SQLite (`local.db`) out of the box during local development and can also connect to remote LibSQL/Turso databases.

## Live URL

- **URL:** [https://money.widifirmaan.web.id](https://money.widifirmaan.web.id)

## Features

- **Authentication and Onboarding:** PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing with HS256 JWT authentication (`/login`), plus an interactive Setup Wizard for new accounts that initializes default categories and starting wallet balances via `POST /api/seed`.
- **Dashboard Overview (`/`):** Displays total net worth with privacy masking, all-time income and expense summary cards, active daily/weekly/monthly budget limit breach alerts, quick wallet modals, and recent transactions.
- **Multi-Wallet Management (`/wallets`):** Create, edit, and delete `bank`, `ewallet`, and `cash` wallets, configure daily/weekly/monthly expense limits, transfer funds between wallets (`POST /api/transfer`), and freeze wallets (`isFrozen`) with API-level enforcement blocking new, edited, or deleted transactions on frozen accounts.
- **Transaction Logging and Receipt Storage (`/add`):** Add income or expense entries with category icons, timestamps, notes, and image receipt uploads (`/api/upload` and `/api/receipts/*`), automatically updating the linked wallet balance.
- **Financial Analytics (`/stats`):** Filter transactions by preset ranges (`This Month`, `Last Month`, `Last 3 Months`, `Custom Range`), transaction type, wallet, or category, inspect top spending category progress bars, paginate results, and edit or delete entries in place.
- **Saved Payment Cards (`/cards`):** Store and manage credit/debit card details (`Visa`, `Mastercard`, `Amex`, `JCB`) with customizable gradient styles.
- **Theme Engine and PWA Support (`/profile`):** Switch across 9 color themes (`Emerald Dream`, `Dark Emerald`, `Dark`, `Light`, `Ocean Blue`, `Royal Purple`, `Coklat Jawa`, `Sunset Orange`, `Rose Garden`) persisted per user, update profile names, reset user data, install via Web App Manifest, or download an iOS `.mobileconfig` web clip profile (`/api/ios-profile`).

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5

## Local Setup

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ (tested with Node.js 26)
- npm

### Quick Start

1. **Install dependencies**

   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

2. **Configure environment variables (optional)**

   The app runs with defaults out of the box using `local.db`. To set a custom JWT secret or connect to a remote LibSQL/Turso database, copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`:

   ```bash
   cp .env.example .env.local
   ```

3. **Initialize and seed the local SQLite database**

   ```bash
   npm run db:setup
   ```

   To wipe and recreate `local.db` from `schema.sql` and `scripts/seed.sql`:

   ```bash
   npm run db:reset
   ```

4. **Start the development server**

   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

5. **Open the application**

   Visit `http://localhost:3000`.

# Siap Nyafe POS > Coffee shop point-of-sale, customer self-ordering portal, kitchen display system, and store management application built with React 18, Vite 5, and SQLite. [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.3.1-61DAFB?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev/) [![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-5.4.21-646CFF?style=flat-square&logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev/) [![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/React_Router-6.30-CA4245?style=flat-square&logo=reactrouter&logoColor=white)](https://reactrouter.com/) [![Axios](https://img.shields.io/badge/Axios-1.18-5A29E4?style=flat-square&logo=axios&logoColor=white)](https://axios-http.com/) [![Swiper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swiper-12.2-6332F6?style=flat-square&logo=swiper&logoColor=white)](https://swiperjs.com/) [![Lucide](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lucide_React-0.292.0-F56565?style=flat-square)](https://lucide.dev/) [![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-libSQL-003B57?style=flat-square&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)](https://sqlite.org/) [![bcryptjs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Auth-bcryptjs_%2B_JWT-111111?style=flat-square)](#tech-stack) --- ## Live URL - **Production:** [https://siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id](https://siapnyafe.widifirmaan.web.id) ## Features - **Public Brand Showcase (`/`)**: Brand landing page featuring typography marquees, mouse-parallax background lettering, an "About Us" story section, latest published news/promos, and a signature menu grid with item specification modals. Content is configurable from `/settings`. - **Customer Self-Ordering Portal (`/order`)**: Unauthenticated digital menu with horizontal category filtering (derived from menu categories excluding `Featured`), item detail and image zoom modals, and a floating cart tray. - **Cart & Order Dispatch**: Guest checkout drawer collecting customer name, table number (or `Take Away`), order notes, and payment method, followed by order confirmation, database submission, and a ticket number summary. - **Table Waiter Assistance (`/order`, `/waiter`)**: Call Waiter button allowing seated customers to request assistance or the bill. `/waiter` polls for new notifications every 5 seconds with a toggleable alert sound. - **Cashier POS Terminal (`/cashier`)**: Order register calculating subtotal, configurable tax (default 10% with an include-tax toggle), manual IDR discount, payment method, quick cash presets (`Exact`, `50,000`, `100,000`, `150,000`, `200,000`), change amount, and a printable receipt modal. - **Operations Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**: Displays today's revenue, today's order count, pending order count, and low-stock ingredient count, along with personal shift clock-in/clock-out attendance tracking (with late alerts) and a shared operational memo note. - **Kitchen Display System (`/kitchen`)**: Order queue refreshed every 5 seconds with status transitions (`PENDING`, `PREPARING`, `READY_TO_SERVE`, `COMPLETED`), customer notes, toggleable chime, completed history, and ticket item editing. - **Menu Management (`/menu`)**: Catalog manager supporting category assignment, pricing, descriptions, gallery images via URL or file upload, and item availability toggles (`available`). - **Ingredient, Recipe & Stock Control (`/inventory`)**: Raw ingredient tracker with minimum stock thresholds (`minThreshold` / `minStock`), plus a Recipes tab mapping ingredients to menu items for automatic stock deduction when orders move to `PREPARING` or `COMPLETED`. - **Staff Directory (`/employees`)**: Employee directory tracking employee IDs (`EMP-MAN-001`, `EMP-BAR-001`, etc.), roles, base salaries, contact info, password updates, active status toggles, and attendance history. - **Weekly Shift Scheduling (`/shifts`)**: Shift matrix across morning, afternoon, and evening slots per day of the week, including a midweek save confirmation prompt and an automated shift balancer. - **Equipment & Asset Register (`/assets`)**: Register of cafe equipment recording purchase date, price, condition (`GOOD`, `NEEDS_MAINTENANCE`, `BROKEN`), location, serial number, and maintenance dates. - **Financial Ledger (`/finance`)**: Cash flow ledger tracking income and expense entries with category/type filters and a net balance summary. - **Customer Feedback (`/feedback`)**: Guest ratings (1 to 5 stars), review messages, average rating summary, and the associated shift staff. - **Promotional Posts & Store Settings (`/posts`, `/settings`)**: Blog/announcement publishing (`/posts`) and store settings (`/settings`) covering shop name, page title, favicon, phone number, hero image, badges, marquee text, info section, tax percentage, and receipt footer. ## Tech Stack | Layer | Technology | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Frontend Framework** | React `18.3.1`, Vite `5.4.21` | SPA frontend with Vite HMR and production bundling | | **Routing** | React Router DOM `6.30.4` | Client-side routing and role-based protected route guards | | **Networking & State** | React Context API, Axios `1.18.1` | Auth state management and HTTP request/401 interceptors | | **Styling & Components** | Custom CSS (`index.css`), Swiper `12.2.0` | Neo-brutalist design tokens and scrollable category selector | | **Icons** | Lucide React `0.292.0` | Vector UI icons across customer and staff interfaces | | **API Runtime** | Web Fetch REST API (`api/[...route].js`) | Request routing for auth, orders, inventory, attendance, and uploads | | **Database** | SQLite / libSQL (`@libsql/client` `0.18.0`) | Relational storage for employees, menus, orders, shifts, and assets | | **Media Storage** | Local Disk / Object Storage / Inline Fallback | Image upload handling for menu items and store branding | | **Security & Auth** | bcryptjs `2.4.3`, JWT (HS256 via Web Crypto) | Password hashing (10 salt rounds) and 7-day Bearer/cookie sessions | ## Screenshots ### 1. # Tryngo - Interactive Coding & Roadmap Platform

Interactive programming curriculum, browser code playgrounds, and adaptive quiz platform built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Monaco Editor, and Fuse.js.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.8-007ACC?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)
![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-6-646CFF?style=for-the-badge&logo=vite&logoColor=white)
![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-4-38B2AC?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)
![Monaco Editor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Monaco_Editor-0.56-007ACC?style=for-the-badge)
![Vitest](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vitest-5-6E9F18?style=for-the-badge&logo=vitest&logoColor=white)

Tryngo serves 28 programming technology roadmaps totaling 664 markdown lessons, per-track adaptive quizzes, and browser code sandboxes. Curriculum data, search indexes, and SEO route pages are generated at build time, while learner progress and UI settings persist in browser `localStorage`.

## Live URL

- **URL:** [https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tryngo.widifirmaan.web.id)

## Features

- **28 Curriculum Roadmaps (664 Lessons):** Covers frontend (`HTML5`, `CSS3`, `Tailwind CSS`, `JavaScript`, `TypeScript`, `React`, `Next.js`, `Vue`, `Svelte`, `Angular`), backend (`Go`, `Rust`, `C#`, `Spring Boot`, `Python`, `Node.js`, `NestJS`, `Django`, `PHP`, `Laravel`, `CodeIgniter 4`, `Ruby on Rails`), databases/APIs (`PostgreSQL`, `MySQL`, `MongoDB`, `Redis`, `GraphQL`), and containers (`Docker`), supporting deep links (`/course/{slug}/{level}/{week}`) and hash routes.
- **In-Browser Code Playground & Online IDE:** Embeds Monaco Editor (`@monaco-editor/react`) with multi-language runners using WebAssembly runtimes (`esbuild-wasm`, Pyodide, Go WASM, SQL WASM), simulated engines, and `@stackblitz/sdk` workspace launching.
- **Fuzzy Curriculum Search (`Modals.tsx`):** Searches across 28 tracks and all 664 indexed lesson files (`public/search-index.json`) powered by `fuse.js`.
- **Interactive Assessments (`QuizModal`):** Per-track and sample quizzes generated into `public/quiz-index.json` with immediate scoring and bilingual (`id` / `en`) prompts.
- **Progress Tracking and Preferences:** Saves completed weeks (`tryngo-learning-progress`), language preference (`id` / `en` via `Fredoka`, `Outfit`, and `Syne` typography), and light/dark theme state in `localStorage`.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Vite 6
- **Styling & Animation:** Tailwind CSS 4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`), Motion (`motion`), FontAwesome Solid, Lucide React
- **Content & Search:** `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm`, `fuse.js`
- **Code Execution & IDE:** Monaco Editor (`@monaco-editor/react`, `monaco-editor`), `@stackblitz/sdk`, `graphql`
- **Testing:** Vitest 5 (`vitest run`)

Interactive student counseling web application and teacher management portal built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NextAuth.js, and SQLite/LibSQL.

![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-LibSQL-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)

Book Games organizes 30 reflection and self-development activities into sequential game levels across five psychological well-being dimensions for high school students (`SMA Negeri 1`). Teachers track student submissions, reset answers, manage accounts, and export reports to Excel, backed locally by SQLite (`local.db`) with optional remote LibSQL/Turso support.

## Live URL

- **URL:** [https://book-games.widifirmaan.web.id](https://book-games.widifirmaan.web.id)

## Features

- **Role-Based Authentication (`/login`, `/dashboard`):** Credential login using NextAuth.js JWT sessions and `bcryptjs` hashing, routing `GURU` accounts to `/dashboard/guru` (enforced server-side) and `SISWA` accounts to `/dashboard/siswa`.
- **30-Level Counseling Journey (`/level/[id]`):** Sequential level unlocking grouped across five chapters (`SELF ACCEPTANCE`, `ENVIRONMENTAL`, `PERSONAL GROWTH`, `PURPOSE IN LIFE`, and `POSITIVE RELATIONS`), including interactive word search (`Level 1`), scalable SVG `<path>` drawing pads (`Level 2` and `Level 10`), guided reflections, playlist prompts (`Level 11`), and goal-setting activities (`Level 30`).
- **Progress Tracking and Award Notifications (`/api/levels/submit`, `/api/awards/clear`):** Persists per-level JSON answers in SQLite, tracks chapter completion timing (`FAST_WORKER_INDUK_*` under 15 minutes) and 7-day submission streaks (`CONSISTENT_WORKER`), and delivers dismissable award notifications on the student dashboard.
- **Teacher Management Portal (`/dashboard/guru`, `/api/users`):** Full student CRUD operations, filtering by school, class (`kelas`), and student name, per-level response inspection and answer reset, plus `.xlsx` spreadsheet export via SheetJS (`xlsx`).
- **Idempotent Database Seeding (`npm run db:setup`, `/api/seed`):** Initializes the `users` schema and seeds demo `guru` and `siswa` accounts with starter Level 1 completion data.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript 5
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 3 (`Nunito` and `Fredoka` typography)
- **Authentication:** NextAuth.js 4 (`CredentialsProvider`, JWT sessions), `bcryptjs`
- **Spreadsheet Export:** SheetJS (`xlsx`)
- **Database:** SQLite / LibSQL (`@libsql/client`)

**Formulas & Functions Guide (`rumus.html`)**: Syntax rules and visual examples for arithmetic operations, `SUM`, `AVERAGE`, `MAX`, `MIN`, `COUNT`, and `IF` logical statements. - **Practical Worksheets (`latsoal.html`, `mulailatsoal.html`)**: Case-study spreadsheet exercises (`m/b (1).png`, `m/b (2).png`) with an external assignment submission link. - **20-Question Evaluation Quiz (`quiz.html`, `mulaiquiz.html`)**: Client-side JavaScript grading across 20 multiple-choice questions, missing-answer validation, `>= 14` (`70%`) pass threshold check, and a Bootstrap 5 result modal. - **Embedded Video Tutorial (`video.html`)**: Responsive `16:9` Bootstrap ratio container wrapping an embedded YouTube tutorial. - **Curriculum Alignment (`kd.html`)**: Basic Competencies (KD 3.4 & 4.4) and achievement indicators (IPK). - **OneUI-Inspired Styling (`assets/css/oneui.css`)**: Card layout with `28px` rounded corners (`--oneui-radius: 28px`), floating icon navigation bar, and welcome-page HTML5 audio playback (`audio.mp3`). - **Bibliography & Team Profiles (`daftarpustaka.html`, `profilpengembang.html`)**: Textbook modals and author/advisor cards. ## Tech Stack | Layer | Technology | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **UI Framework** | Bootstrap `5.0.0-beta2` | Grid system, pill tabs, modals, and `ratio-16x9` helpers | | **Styling & Typography** | OneUI CSS (`assets/css/oneui.css`), Poppins | Custom design tokens (`--oneui-radius: 28px`), animations, floating navbar | | **Icons** | Font Awesome `5.15.3` | Subject cards and navigation bar icons | | **Client Scripts & Media** | Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5 Audio, YouTube Iframe | Quiz scoring logic, tab auto-scroll, audio narration, tutorial video | ## Screenshots | Desktop | Mobile | | :---: | :---: | | **Welcome Portal & Audio Narration**

# JavaScript AIO Tools Collection of 23 client-side web utilities for document processing, media editing, cryptography, and developer productivity running directly in the browser. ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-ES6+-F7DF1E?style=flat-square&logo=javascript&logoColor=black) ![HTML5](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-CSS3-E34F26?style=flat-square&logo=html5&logoColor=white) ![WebAssembly](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebAssembly-On--Device_ML-654FF0?style=flat-square&logo=webassembly&logoColor=white) ![Bootstrap](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bootstrap-5.3.7-7952B3?style=flat-square&logo=bootstrap&logoColor=white) ## Live URL - **Production**: [https://tools.widifirmaan.web.id](https://tools.widifirmaan.web.id) ## Features - **Cryptography & Security**: - **File Encryptor (`tools/file-encryptor.html`)**: Browser-memory AES-256-GCM file encryption and decryption using PBKDF2-SHA-256 key derivation (`100,000` iterations) via the Web Crypto API (`SubtleCrypto`). - **Steganography Studio (`tools/steganography.html`)**: RGB Least Significant Bit (LSB) PNG steganography with optional AES-128-GCM password protection (`10,000` PBKDF2 iterations). - **Password Generator (`tools/password-generator.html`)**: CSPRNG password and multi-word English passphrase generation (`104`-word list via `crypto.getRandomValues`) with bit-length keyspace entropy calculation (`L * log2(N)`). - **Documents & Developer Utilities**: - **PDF Tools (`tools/pdf-tools.html`)** & **PDF Splitter (`tools/pdf-splitter.html`)**: Client-side PDF merging, image-to-PDF conversion, page thumbnail previews, and page-range extraction with PDF-Lib and Mozilla PDF.js. - **Developer Toolbox (`tools/dev-tools.html`)**: JSON formatter/validator, Base64/URL encoder-decoder, and client-side JWT payload inspector. - **Regex Visualizer (`tools/regex-visualizer.html`)**: Live regular expression matching, capture group extraction, and SVG railroad syntax diagrams. - **Text Diff (`tools/text-diff.html`)** & **Text Editor (`tools/text-editor.html`)**: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) line diff comparator and plain text/word-count workspace. - **Images, Barcodes & Graphics**: - **Background Remover (`tools/remove-bg.html`)**: On-device foreground cutout using `@imgly/background-removal` WebAssembly runtime (with COOP/COEP cross-origin isolation headers configured in `_headers` and `vercel.json`). - **Image Compressor (`tools/image-compressor.html`)** & **Image Converter (`tools/image-converter.html`)**: HTML5 Canvas image compression and JPG/PNG/WebP format conversion. - **Color Palette Extractor (`tools/color-palette.html`)**: Median-Cut color quantization with CSS variable, JSON, and PNG swatch export. - **SVG Minifier (`tools/svg-minifier.html`)**: XML header/comment/metadata cleanup, coordinate rounding, and side-by-side vector preview. - **Photo Metadata (`tools/photo-metadata.html`)**: Pure JavaScript binary JPEG IFD0 EXIF header viewer (camera make/model, software, timestamp, exposure/aperture/ISO) and canvas-based EXIF stripping. - **QR Code Studio (`tools/qr-code.html`)** & **Barcode Studio (`tools/barcode-studio.html`)**: QR generation/webcam scanning (`QRCode.js`, `Html5-QRCode`) plus pure JavaScript SVG barcode rendering (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14). - **ASCII Art Generator (`tools/ascii-art.html`)**: Image-to-ASCII conversion with plain text, HTML, and ANSI color output. - **Audio, Recording & Calculators**: - **Audio Cutter (`tools/audio-cutter.html`)** & **Instrument Tuner (`tools/audio-tuner.html`)**: Web Audio waveform slicing with fade controls and WAV export, plus time-domain autocorrelation pitch detection with parabolic interpolation and FFT spectrum view. - **Screen Recorder (`tools/screen-recorder.html`)**: Display capture and recording via `getDisplayMedia` and `MediaRecorder` with WebM download. - **Scientific Calculator (`tools/calculator.html`)** & **Tire Comparison (`tools/tire-comp.html`)**: Client-side scientific expression evaluator and tire/wheel diameter & speedometer delta calculator. ## Tech Stack | Layer | Technology | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core** | Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 | Zero-bundler static multi-page architecture | | **UI** | Bootstrap `5.3.7`, Bootstrap Icons, AOS | Responsive dark UI and scroll reveal transitions | | **Cryptography** | Web Crypto API (`SubtleCrypto`) | AES-GCM encryption and PBKDF2 key derivation | | **Documents** | Mozilla PDF.js, PDF-Lib | Browser PDF rendering, splitting, and merging | | **Media & ML** | Web Audio API, MediaRecorder, `@imgly/background-removal` | Audio DSP, screen capture, and WASM background cutout | | **Codes & Scanning** | QRCode.js, Html5-QRCode, Custom SVG Encoders | QR generation/decoding and 1D vector barcodes | ## Screenshots | Desktop | Mobile | | :---: | :---: | | **Main Dashboard & 23-Tool Grid**
